body: Tama ang framing na hindi sapat ang stronger factory orders para tawaging clean earnings recovery. Market lens: ang mas importanteng test ngayon ay kung kaya ng firms i-convert ang order growth into margins habang sabay na mataas ang energy at discount rates. Today's broad Tokyo selloff makes that distinction more urgent, pero hindi pa nito pinapatunayang babagsak ang manufacturing cycle itself. Demand can improve while equity multiples compress — magkaibang question iyon.
